column1: # Core of the world model (onto v2): concepts compiled into "normal compiled life" (docs/context.md, "The core is compiled").
# OEWN lemma (underscore = space) and domain → lexicographer file for sense choice: animal → noun.animal, food → noun.food,
# plant → noun.plant, household → noun.artifact, family/role/magical → noun.person. Animals — from fables and tales (world classes
# world/data and the city's core-classes), food, household, family and roles. Walker: onto wd-walk.
# v3: third column — an explicit synset when the first sense in the domain's lexfile is wrong (dolphin — dolphinfish, oak — wood,
# net — internet, bow — a hair bow, peacock — a butterfly…): 27 concepts, checked by hand against OEWN glosses (onto word).
# v3: the core gate showed: nut, acorn (synsets are plant parts, noun.plant) and walnut — domain food vs seed d55 "an object is not food";
# resolved with seeds d74–d75 (a nut is edible), the domain stayed food; a lexfile outside the domain is only a warning (nut, acorn, coin).
